title: 第21章 巡检司成长交代事情外出游历洪荒第22章 唯恐天下不乱的树妖斗梅山妖仙
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 上清峰外。
一处高耸山峰。
此山被青渊命名为醒峰，醒峰上建立一片宫殿，最前边的城楼牌坊匾额上写着‘巡检司’三个大字。
山名为醒山，是因为截教大师兄青渊为让门人谨记门规纪律、每日自省吾身，故而命名为醒峰。
自当初青渊清肃截教上下逞凶作恶的弟子，又教训阐教仙替众人出一口气，声望到达了一个鼎盛地步，多宝道人、金灵圣母、无当圣母等一众内门弟子以及外门杰出弟子们也认可大师兄，替巡检司卖力。
巡检司从短短十人。
也发展到了近百号人。
司内分别建立警、惩、查、规四科，如同一柄利剑竖在截教每一个弟子头顶。
这百来年时间里运转机构，让截教门风好了许多。
只是让青渊头疼的是。
他师父通天教主是真的来者不拒、个个都收，但收了之后却又不管，而大多数生灵都遵循着野兽法则，凶残暴戾、勾心斗角，且自私自利，极难管束。
哪怕有巡检司一次次镇压祸端。
但这种骨子里的东西，并不是门规能够束缚的。
面对这种情况。
青渊也暂时无可奈何。
将巡检司完善的差不多之后，便让其自我发展，不多插手巡检司的演变过程。
种子种下了，只待生根发芽成长为一棵滔天巨树。
未来门规纪律一旦深深印入绝大多数弟子心里，就会形成一种特有的‘组织文化’，后面加入进来的弟子不遵守便会遭到‘世俗目光’的厌恶鄙夷，慢慢的融入这种观念当中。
亦如随地大小便这一点。
青渊见到过不少次有生灵真的敢当着大众的面拉屎。
拉完了还要回头看看情况。
后面建立门规禁制随地大小便与讲文明树新风之后随地大小便的人就少了很多。
青渊，不敢奢求一个个截教弟子都‘知书达理’。
只希望能慢慢教化这些门人，让截教内形成一种规矩与观念，便不负他的筹划了。
清幽峰。
波涛滚滚的大江里。
两道身影正在江面上厮杀，手中都持着长棍。
一道身影巍然不动、气定神闲。
另外那道怒猿身影则是攻势汹涌惊天动地，却伤不到玄衣青年半分，反倒被看似轻飘飘的一棍砸出数万米外，重重的掉入江面。
哗~
水面划开。
无支祈从水中露出个脑袋，敬佩道：“师父，您这棍法也太厉害了吧？明明您将道行压制在玄仙中期，却怎么能将我压制的这么死呢？我感觉你都意料到了我出棍的方向。”
content_en:
Outside Shangqing Peak.
A towering mountain peak.
This mountain was named Xingfeng by Qingyuan. A palace was built on Xingfeng. The three characters "Inspection Department" were written on the plaque on the front gate tower.
The name of the mountain is Xingshan because Qingyuan, the senior brother of Jiejiao, wanted his disciples to remember the rules and disciplines of the sect and to self-examine themselves every day, so he named it Xingfeng.
Ever since Qingyuan purged the evil disciples from above and below the Jiejiao sect, and taught the Chanjiao Immortal to give a sigh of relief to everyone, his reputation has reached a peak. Taoist Duobao, Jinling Holy Mother, Wudang Holy Mother and other inner disciples as well as outstanding outer sect disciples also recognized the senior brother and worked hard for the Inspection Department.
The Inspection Department has grown from just ten people.
It has also grown to nearly a hundred people.
The department has established four departments: police, punishment, investigation, and regulation, which are like a sharp sword standing over the head of every disciple of Jiejiao.
Over the past hundred years, the organization has improved a lot.
What just gives Qingyuan a headache.
His master, Master Tongtian, really accepts everyone who comes, but after accepting them, he ignores them. Most creatures follow the law of beasts, are brutal, scheming, selfish, and extremely difficult to control.
Even if there is an inspection department that suppresses the trouble again and again.
But this kind of deep-rooted thing cannot be restricted by sect rules.
Face this situation.
Qingyuan was also helpless for the time being.
After the inspection department is almost perfected, let it develop on its own without interfering much in the evolution of the inspection department.
The seed is planted, just waiting to take root and grow into a giant tree.
In the future, once the sect's rules and disciplines are deeply ingrained in the hearts of most disciples, a unique "organizational culture" will be formed. If the disciples who join later do not abide by it, they will be disgusted and despised by the "secular eyes" and slowly integrate into this concept.
Just like urinating in public.
Qingyuan has seen many times that there are creatures who really dare to poop in front of the public.
After pulling, I have to look back and check the situation.
After the establishment of door rules to prohibit open defecation and the promotion of civility and the establishment of new trends, there were many fewer people defecating in the open.
Qing Yuan does not dare to expect that every Jie Jiao disciple should be "well-informed".
He only hopes that he can slowly educate these disciples and form a set of rules and concepts within Jie Jiao, so that he can live up to his plan.
Qingyou Peak.
In the rolling river.
Two figures were fighting on the river, both holding long sticks in their hands.
A figure stood still and calm.
The other figure of the angry ape made an earth-shattering attack, but it was unable to injure the young man in Xuanyi. Instead, he was thrown tens of thousands of meters away by a seemingly light stick, and fell heavily into the river.
Wow~
The water split.
Wuzhiqi popped his head out of the water and said in admiration: "Master, your stick technique is too powerful, isn't it? You obviously suppressed Daoxing in the middle stage of Xuanxian, but how could you suppress me to death like this? I feel like you have anticipated the direction of my stick."
title_en: Chapter 21: The Inspection Department grows up and explains the matter and goes out to travel in the wilderness Chapter 22: The tree demon who fears that the world will not be in chaos fights the Meishan demon fairy
